title: Every evening
note: Choosing a cadence updates the evenings and the time (7 AM to 9:30 PM; quiet on a day already written). The time picker is a native control and does not open on web.
text: Reminders Reminders A gentle nudge a few evenings a week, at the time you choose. Never late at night. Notifications are off for this app Turn them on in your phone's Settings and your reminders start again. Open Settings How often Weekly A few times a week Every evening Time Reminder time 8:30 PM Reminders come between 7 AM and 9:30 PM, and stay quiet on a day you have already written. Month notes A short note on the day a new month begins in each book, and on birthdays. Names in notifications Notifications say "your little one" and show no names on the lock screen. Pause all reminders
